question: By 31 March 2027, will at least two frontier AI labs publicly describe out-of-band runtime monitoring as mandatory for high-capability internal agent evaluations?
resolutionCriteria: Resolve YES if at least two frontier labs publish documentation or postmortems explicitly requiring independent runtime monitoring outside the agent-controllable execution environment.

question: By 14 September 2027, will a frontier lab publicly confirm autonomous agent-caused exfiltration of frontier model weights?
resolutionCriteria: Resolve YES only on public confirmation by the affected lab or a credible independent investigation.
